name: Bright Eye Solar
old_description: As a locally owned solar installer, we handle everything from your first energy audit to system design, permitting, and installation
about:
Bright Eye Solar is a locally owned solar installation company based in Lancaster, Pennsylvania. Founded in 2010 by Jim Noden, who serves as owner and CEO, the firm began as a full-service installer handling energy audits, system design, permitting, and installation for residential and commercial customers.

The company provides end-to-end solar solutions including rooftop and ground‑mounted photovoltaic systems, battery storage integration, and ongoing maintenance and repair. To date it has completed over 1,600 installations, avoiding an estimated 12,000 metric tons of CO₂ annually and saving customers roughly $2.8 million per year. A team of ten — including a master electrician, project manager, warehouse manager, and multiple solar consultants — supports operations across Pennsylvania, Maryland, and New Jersey.

Bright Eye Solar serves homeowners and businesses throughout Lancaster County and the surrounding region, extending into Maryland and New Jersey. Its residential work covers custom solar arrays for single‑family homes, while commercial projects focus on reducing operational energy costs for companies of various sizes. The firm also assists clients with financing options and incentive navigation.

The company emphasizes its NABCEP certification, transparent proposal process, and a proven local track record as key differentiators. It promotes a streamlined installation workflow that typically completes residential projects within 30 days after approvals, and it offers ground‑mounted alternatives when roof space is limited.
